name: help
description: Frequently asked questions shown on the site (footer page, #faq)

faq.question: What is the cancellation and refund policy at BW Stays Wayanad?
faq.answer: Standard dates: cancel 15 or more days before check-in for a full refund (less payment-gateway or bank charges), 7 to 14 days before for a 50% refund, and less than 7 days before or no-show for no refund. Holiday and peak-season stays (public holidays, festival weekends, 20 December to 5 January): 30 or more days before for a full refund, 15 to 29 days before for 50%, and less than 15 days before or no-show for no refund. You can move a confirmed booking once, free of charge, up to 7 days before check-in, subject to availability. Refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 7 to 10 working days. Full details: https://www.bwstays.com/footer.html#cancellation

faq.question: What does the villa cost per night?
faq.answer: The villa is listed at INR 2,100 per night on the booking page, for up to 4 adults and 1 child, and the rate includes GST. Each extra child (up to 4 children in all) is INR 400 per night. The final amount is confirmed by the host by email.

faq.question: How do I book the villa?
faq.answer: Open the booking page, choose your check-in and check-out dates on the calendar, select the villa, enter your details and send the request. A booking is a request: your dates are held only after the host confirms by email. A one-page summary of your request can be saved as a PDF. Booking page: https://www.bwstays.com/bwstays-booking.html

faq.question: How can I check availability?
faq.answer: The calendar on the booking page shows booked and closed dates (dates already requested may show as Requested), and you can choose dates from today up to one year ahead. A requested date is not confirmed yet. The host confirms every booking by email.

faq.question: How many people can stay in the villa?
faq.answer: The villa takes up to 4 adults and up to 4 children (0 to 12 years); the booking page does not accept more. The nightly rate covers 4 adults and 1 child; each extra child is INR 400 per night (extra bed). The villa has 2 beds and 1 bathroom, a garden and private parking, and pets are allowed.

faq.question: What amenities does the villa have?
faq.answer: EV charging, private parking, eco-friendly, premium utensils, a kitchen set, bonfire and music, television, online games, high-speed WiFi, security, pet friendly, bathroom amenities, air conditioning, a mountain view and a garden.

faq.question: Is the villa suitable for a workation?
faq.answer: High-speed WiFi and air conditioning are listed among the villa amenities, so it suits remote work. The WiFi speed is not published, so ask the host if you need a specific bandwidth.

faq.question: Where is the villa located?
faq.answer: In Kalpetta, Wayanad, Kerala (PIN 673121), close to the city centre. The Places to visit page lists attractions with their driving distance from Kalpetta (https://www.bwstays.com/all-locations-wayanad.html), and the Places to eat page lists restaurants and cafes (https://www.bwstays.com/all-fooding-wayanad.html).

faq.question: Which places can I visit near the villa?
faq.answer: The site lists waterfalls, view points, lakes, temples, museums, plantations, wildlife sanctuaries and treks around Wayanad, each with a page showing timings, rating and distance from Kalpetta. Nearby EV charging stations and fuel stations are shown on each place page. Start at https://www.bwstays.com/all-locations-wayanad.html

faq.question: Is there EV charging near the villa?
faq.answer: EV charging is listed among the villa amenities. Every place page also shows nearby public and private charging stations and fuel stations on a map; their positions are approximate.

faq.question: Can I use the website without internet?
faq.answer: Yes, partly. The website can be installed on a phone (Add to Home Screen) and keeps the pages you have opened, the places, food, charging and fuel lists and the policies available offline. Live availability, sending a booking request, the chat assistant, the weather and the currency rates need an internet connection.

faq.question: What is the concept behind Black and White Stays?
faq.answer: Colive, Cowork and Coplay: a villa in Kalpetta for staying with family or friends, working remotely, and exploring Wayanad.

faq.question: Summarize BW Stays Wayanad in one sentence
faq.answer: Black and White Stays is a single villa in Kalpetta, Wayanad for staycations and workations, for up to 4 adults and 4 children, listed at INR 2,100 per night.
